Delete your data

Last updated: 2026-11-04

PrivacyTermsSupportDelete your data

Hushwalls has no accounts and no server of ours that stores your data, so there is no account to delete. Everything the app keeps is on your own device, and you control it.

On your phone

  • Clear stored images: Settings in Hushwalls, then clear the image cache.
  • Remove everything the app keeps (your picks, the cached list, ad counters, consent choices): Android Settings, Apps, Hushwalls, Storage, Clear data. Uninstalling the app removes it all too.
  • Wallpapers you saved with the save button are normal pictures in your gallery (Pictures/Hushwalls). Delete them there if you no longer want them.

Data held by other companies

Google (ads) and RevenueCat (your Remove ads purchase) keep data under their own policies. To ask about purchase records, or to ask us to pass a deletion request on, email us. You can reset your advertising ID and opt out of ads personalization in Android Settings, and change your ad choice in Hushwalls under Settings, Ad privacy options, where that option is shown.

Questions or requests

Email mercurysols197@gmail.com and we will answer within 30 days. See also the privacy policy.
